user.title: Sign in to Lomi
user.description: Use the same email and password as the Lomi app.

register.title: Register a Lomi
register.description: No Lomi is registered to {email} yet. Enter the serial number printed on the device (or skip and register in the app later).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Lomi
reauth_confirm.description: The Lomi cloud rejected the stored credentials for {email}. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Lomi cloud
error.register_failed: The Lomi cloud rejected that serial number

abort.already_configured: This Lomi account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: Signed in to a different account than the one being re-authenticated

data_description.poll_interval: How often to fetch the device record from the Lomi cloud.
data_description.poll_device_status: Transient status route; observed empty while idle, may carry cycle state.
data_description.poll_pending_commands: Needed for scheduled-start and command-acknowledged tracking.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw remote command to a Lomi (start, pause, resume, stop or program change).

mode.name: Program
mode.description: Program to use; defaults to the Program selector's value.

start_at.name: Start at
start_at.description: Optional future time to issue the command (scheduled start).

schedule_start.name: Schedule start
schedule_start.description: Schedule a cycle to start at a future time.

mode.name: Program
mode.description: Program to use; defaults to the Program selector's value.

cancel_scheduled.name: Cancel scheduled start
cancel_scheduled.description: Cancel one scheduled command, or all scheduled starts for the device.

command_id.name: Command ID
command_id.description: Specific command to cancel. Leave empty to cancel every scheduled start.

register_device.name: Register device
register_device.description: Register a Lomi to the account by serial number.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Lomi account to use (only needed with several accounts).

serial_number.name: Serial number
serial_number.description: Serial printed on the device, e.g. L3GBA0625000514.

nickname.name: Nickname
nickname.description: Name shown in the Lomi app and Home Assistant.

device_not_loaded.message: Device {device_id} belongs to a Lomi account that is not loaded.

start_time_in_past.message: Start time {start_at} is not in the future.

ambiguous_entry.message: Specify which Lomi account to use (config_entry_id).
